text: ∀x (Theater(x) ↔ (VenueForLiveStagePerformances(x) ∧ Stage(x) ∧ Curtains(x) ∧ AudienceSeating(x) ∧ (HostsPlays(x) ∨ HostsMusicals(x) ∨ HostsOtherProductions(x)))) ::: A place is considered a theater if it is a venue for live stage performances, often with a stage, curtains, and audience seating, and hosting plays, musicals, or other productions.
